title: AOSP Repo, Sync, Build, and Source-tree Navigation

scout.purpose: Master aosp repo, sync, build, and source-tree navigation through a production or platform contract supported by causal evidence.
scout.realWorldUse: Specialist Android work must remain compatible, secure, measurable, accessible, distributable, and operable outside a demonstration.
scout.outcome: You can design, inspect, test, release, and defend aosp repo, sync, build, and source-tree navigation.

blocks.text: AOSP is a superproject assembled from many Git repositories by Repo and a manifest. Select an explicit release branch or tag rather than assuming main matches a target device. Current platform development requires a supported Linux host and substantial disk, RAM, network, and build time. repo init chooses manifest source and revision; repo sync fetches projects. A local manifest can add or override projects for a product without editing the upstream manifest.

blocks.text: Source envsetup.sh defines helpers, lunch selects a product-release-variant target, and m invokes the build. Output belongs under out or a deliberate OUT_DIR. The tree separates frameworks, system, packages, hardware, build, art, bionic, external, device, vendor, and tests, but ownership and project boundaries matter more than directory names. Use repo status, repo forall, Git history, OWNERS, build module queries, and Android Code Search to locate responsibility before changing code.

blocks.code: repo init --partial-clone -b android-latest-release -u https://android.googlesource.com/platform/manifest; repo sync -c -j8; source build/envsetup.sh; lunch aosp_cf_x86_64_only_phone-aosp_current-userdebug; m
blocks.caption: A focused fragment whose complete contract includes exact versions, ownership, adverse paths, compatibility, and release evidence.

blocks.text: Record manifest revision, branch, host, build target, commands, artifact hashes, and test result. Start with a narrow module build before full system image, then boot Cuttlefish or a supported target. Never mix products in one output assumption or compare unclean builds casually. Validate proprietary binary requirements and licensing. AOSP alone is not a complete commercial device stack or Google services distribution. Keep experiments on Repo branches per Git project.

Expert engineering makes assumptions, authority, compatibility, security, privacy, accessibility, performance, distribution, and recovery reviewable. Begin with a concrete user or platform outcome, identify trust and lifecycle boundaries, and retain exact source, dependency, toolchain, configuration, model or platform version, and artifact identity. Test realistic success plus denial, offline, process death, cancellation, corruption, version skew, resource pressure, and dependency failure. Measure representative distributions rather than best runs. Document unsupported cases, residual risk, owners, release gates, incident response, deprecation, and rollback or roll-forward. A specialised solution is production-ready only when another team can integrate, verify, operate, upgrade, disable, and remove it safely.

trap_check.mistake: Editing files across several Git projects on one ordinary branch misses Repo project boundaries and makes upload or review incomplete.
trap_check.why: It hides an ownership, compatibility, trust, lifecycle, or evidence gap that becomes costly outside the demonstration.
trap_check.fix: Make the disputed boundary explicit and add a representative negative or compatibility test plus operational response.

trap_check.mistake: Treating one successful device, client, model, platform build, or release as proof of the supported contract.
trap_check.why: Advanced Android ecosystems contain version, hardware, consumer, policy, and runtime variation.
trap_check.fix: Define the support matrix and verify exact artifacts across representative and adverse conditions.

challenge_intro.task: Create a reproducible AOSP workspace and build record, locate a framework behavior across projects, build its module and image, boot it, and preserve evidence.
challenge_intro.successLooksLike: The work includes a minimal coherent implementation, exact evidence, support and threat boundaries, adverse testing, release operation, and recovery.

recall.prompt: What does a Repo manifest determine?
recall.answer: Which Git projects, revisions, remotes, paths, and groups compose the checked-out AOSP workspace.

recall.prompt: What must accompany an expert Android artifact?
recall.answer: Exact source and build identity, supported versions, contracts, tests, measurements, security and privacy review, release evidence, owner, and recovery plan.
They prevent consumers and operators from treating an untested or impossible condition as a silent guarantee.
